notes_for_editor: Only tnlandforms.us names this tower; its entry has coordinates, county and an unexplained note 'datasheet BS0397', with no build date, agency, status or access. Not on NHLR's Georgia list or FFLOS's Georgia list (2 former sites), both checked in the local crawl. The list point is about 1.5 km north of Wikipedia's community coordinates (31.61306, -82.73472), so the tower position is unverified. The GFC sentence is statewide context only; no source ties it to this site. Brief status and access 'unknown' left unchanged. Two WebSearch queries run, neither returned a tower-specific page.
